documents.shelfmark: ASV Segreteria di Stato, Portogallo 8, ff. 92r-101r (DECODE R190, R191)

plaintext.source: Contemporary interlinear decipherment; Lasry's DECODE decryption (DOC_R190_D3249, 2020).

transcription.source: Midas 2017 transcription as decrypted by Lasry (DOC_R190_D3249)
transcription.notes: Count of groups in Lasry's decryption file, counted by script, not by the profile checker; 474 marked uncertain. Not re-transcribed here.

documents.shelfmark: ASV Segreteria di Stato, Portogallo 8, ff. 195-197, 236-238, 281 (DECODE R192, R193, R194)

plaintext.source: Contemporary interlinear decipherment over nearly every passage; R193 p.3 a clear decifrato.

transcription.source: sauli1579/transcription_R192.md, transcription_R193_R194.md (per-passage digit strings from the DECODE images)
transcription.notes: About 106 cipher passages; digit strings read approximately and checked against the glosses, not an independent full count.

system.summary: Two-digit homophones for letters with a few two-digit code words, single digit 9 as null word separator.
system.notes: Lasry's key (DOC_R190_D3258) plus 16 Inghilterra, 30 S.S.ta, 36 Francia, 40 cattolici, 10 Italia(?) found here; 20/28, 72/82 and 4-digit prefixes unsettled.

prior_solution.where: Contemporary interlinear decipherments on the letters; Lasry's reconstructed key and R190-R191 decryption on DECODE (Oct 2020)

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: decrypt.py (Lasry's key as a table decoder)

solution.what: DECODE R190-R194 metadata, 22 page images and DOC attachments fetched with the session cookie; Lasry's key and his R190-R191 decryption found on the records.
Web search for an edition of Riario's legation letters; none found.
Lasry's reconstructed key coded as decrypt.py.
Cipher passages of R192-R194 (11 pp.) transcribed as digits by two image agents, with the interlinear glosses and page summaries.
Each decrypt compared with the contemporary gloss: agreement wherever legible; only one short tail on R192 p.1 lacks a gloss.
Code words added to the key from gloss alignment: 16 Inghilterra, 30 S.S.ta, 36 Francia, 40 cattolici, 10 Italia(?).

outcome.method_basis: Nearly every cipher passage in Portogallo 8 carries the secretariat's contemporary interlinear decipherment; the passages were transcribed and each decrypted with Lasry's key (DECODE, Oct 2020) only to check the gloss, with which it agreed wherever legible.
outcome.notes: Read from the contemporary decipherments, checked with the key; a few code groups (20/28, 72/82, 4-digit prefixes, one tail) open.
